_comment: Daily routine shown on the dashboard. Ticks reset each day and are saved only in your browser.
items: Review sanctions updates (UK OFSI / UK Sanctions List, OFAC, UN) and re-screen if lists changed
Clear overnight screening and transaction-monitoring alerts
Review internal suspicious activity reports received; decide on onward SARs to the FIA
Check FATF / CFATF news and any changes to high-risk jurisdictions
Follow up open FIA requests, production orders and consent matters
Check outstanding EDD reviews and periodic KYC refreshes due
Note anything for the MLRO log / Board report
